description: LoRA fine-tuning configuration for the Detection Agent (Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). Approved by team decision D-010. Run on a GPU machine only — see docs/PHASE2_TRAINING.md.

sampling.description: Cap each class at max_per_class to reduce imbalance while keeping all minority classes intact. Preserves the original splits — writes new files to data/phase2/. See docs/LLM_FINE_TUNING.md for the recommended 2k-5k target.

evaluation.note: Run python -m src.cli calibrate and then python -m src.cli evaluate (with PHASE=2 DETECTION_MODEL=<adapter>) after training. Uses the same 494-event frozen test subset as Phase 1 (data/eval/phase1_eval_subset_ids.json).
